description: Use for QuickBooks questions like "are our QuickBooks books clean", "can I trust the numbers in QuickBooks", "are we ready to close the month in QuickBooks", "does the QuickBooks trial balance balance", "how much is in Uncategorized Expense", "what's still uncleared in QuickBooks", "does receivables match the AR aging", or "did anything change before the closing date" — and before trusting any QuickBooks profit, cash or balance sheet figure, even when the user never says "audit" or "close". Use when the decision is whether the QuickBooks books can be reported on yet, not what they say. QuickBooks only; for Xero use xero-books-health-and-close-check.
